name: Simple File Manager
summary:
Simple File Manager turns your headset into a full file manager.

FEATURES
- Browse internal storage with grid or list view, sort by name, date, size or type
- Categorized views for Images, Videos, Audio, Documents, Apps, Archives, Downloads and Large files
- Multi-select copy, cut, paste, rename, delete and share
- Built-in zip compress and extract
- Image viewer with pinch-zoom and a text file viewer/editor
- Trash with restore, so deletes are never permanent by accident
- Favorites and recent files for q
